body:
Founder real-time: decal was being smooshed into a fixed square. spray_tex_for_id now returns the real width/height ratio from the already-decoded texture; draw_spray_decals scales the shorter axis down from the real half-size instead of using a fixed sz for both axes. Live-verified under Xvfb -- a portrait spray (256x421) now renders as a real tall rectangle, not a squashed square. All three build paths clean. Commit SHANKPIT a97ff9a (+ ab7dfa4 changelog).

⚓ ☃
title: Fix: spray decals keep their real aspect ratio instead of a squashed square
